daily.title: Brazilian Diplomacy Will Not Comment on Trump's Defeat, but Lula Government Sees End of Imperial Stance
daily.summary:
Brazil's Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not issue a statement on the results of the U.S. midterm elections. However, diplomats and members of the Lula administration believe the defeat was decisive and should change the Republican president's behavior on the world stage.
